about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Razeem Real Estate — your trusted partner in the Saudi property market
about.intro: Razeem Real Estate is a Saudi platform for listing, marketing and managing property. We bring owners and seekers together in one trusted place, and offer property management for owners who want peace of mind.
about.mission: To simplify the search for the right property and give every party a transparent, safe experience — by verifying publishers through Nafath and reviewing every listing before it goes live.
about.vision: To be the Kingdom's most trusted property platform in content quality, and an active contributor to the housing goals of Vision 2030.
about.valueTrustDesc: Every publisher is Nafath verified, and every listing is reviewed before publishing.
about.valueTransparencyDesc: Clear data and stated prices — no hidden fees, no surprises.
about.valueQualityDesc: We review photos and details so what you see is what you get.
about.valueServiceDesc: A team ready to answer your questions and follow up on your requests.
about.serviceListingDesc: Put your property up for sale or rent and reach thousands of seekers.
about.serviceSearchDesc: Browse thousands of listings with precise filters and an interactive map.
about.serviceRequestsDesc: Describe what you are looking for and let owners come to you.
about.serviceManagementDesc: We handle letting, maintenance and follow-up for your property.
about.ctaDesc: Browse the available properties or get in touch to learn more.

managementLanding.heroSubtitle: We handle letting, rent collection, maintenance and tenants, and send you a clear report every month. You own the property — we do the rest.
managementLanding.challengesTitle: We know what makes managing a property exhausting
managementLanding.challengesSubtitle: These are the problems owners face most — and we solve all of them
managementLanding.challenge1Desc: Repeated chasing and delays that eat your time and postpone your income.
managementLanding.challenge2Desc: Every empty unit is a monthly loss you never get back.
managementLanding.challenge3Desc: Calls at awkward hours and an urgent search for a technician you can trust.
managementLanding.challenge4Desc: Registering contracts and staying compliant needs constant attention.
managementLanding.challenge5Desc: You do not know exactly what your property earned or what it cost.
managementLanding.challenge6Desc: Breaches, late move-outs and disputes that take experience to handle.
managementLanding.tiersSubtitle: Two clear packages, no hidden fees
managementLanding.tier1Tagline: For owners who want letting and collection handled properly
managementLanding.tier1Feature1: Marketing your units on the Razeem platform
managementLanding.tier1Feature2: Screening tenants and checking they are serious
managementLanding.tier2Tagline: End-to-end management with no involvement from you
managementLanding.tier2Feature6: Detailed reports and property performance metrics
managementLanding.stepsSubtitle: Four steps between you and peace of mind
managementLanding.step1Desc: You send your property details; our team visits and values its real rental income.
managementLanding.step2Desc: We agree the package and the fees in writing, with no vague clauses.
managementLanding.step3Desc: We prepare, photograph and list the property so it reaches the widest audience.
managementLanding.step4Desc: We run everything day to day, and you get a monthly report covering all of it.
managementLanding.advantagesSubtitle: Nine reasons property owners trust us
managementLanding.advantage1Desc: We know the Kingdom's districts and their real prices, so we price accurately.
managementLanding.advantage2Desc: Every riyal in and out is documented in a report you can see yourself.
managementLanding.advantage3Desc: We verify means and rental history before any contract is signed.
managementLanding.advantage4Desc: A network of approved technicians at prices agreed in advance.
managementLanding.advantage5Desc: Registered contracts and full compliance with Saudi rental regulations.
managementLanding.advantage6Desc: Marketing starts before the current contract ends, cutting empty days.
managementLanding.advantage7Desc: Proactive follow-up on payments and clear steps when they are late.
managementLanding.advantage8Desc: Preventive maintenance keeps the property from deteriorating over time.
managementLanding.advantage9Desc: A dedicated account manager who always answers — no transfers.
managementLanding.faq1Q: How much are the management fees?
managementLanding.faq1A: Fees are a percentage of the annual rent and vary by package and number of units. We state the percentage clearly in the proposal before any agreement is signed, and there are no hidden fees.
managementLanding.faq2Q: Can I end the agreement whenever I want?
managementLanding.faq2A: Yes. The agreement is annual and can be ended with prior notice as agreed, with all contracts and documents handed back to you in full.
managementLanding.faq3A: Maintenance costs sit with the owner, but we carry the work out at prices agreed in advance and never exceed the agreed spending limit without your approval.
managementLanding.faq4Q: How do you choose a tenant?
managementLanding.faq4A: We verify identity, financial standing and previous rental history, and no contract is signed until those checks pass.
managementLanding.faq5Q: When do I receive the rent?
managementLanding.faq5A: We transfer your share straight after collection on the agreed schedule, with a statement of amounts and any deductions.
managementLanding.faq6A: Yes — commercial buildings, offices, shops and warehouses as well as residential property.
managementLanding.ctaTitle: Ready to hand your property to a team that cares for it?
managementLanding.ctaSubtitle: Send your details today and our property-management team will contact you within one business day.

marketingLanding.heroTitle: Your property deserves its real price — and a serious buyer
marketingLanding.heroSubtitle: We price your property against the market, photograph it properly, and put it in front of thousands of serious searchers. You review the offers; we handle the marketing and the negotiation through to completion.
marketingLanding.challengesTitle: Why marketing a property yourself is exhausting
marketingLanding.challengesSubtitle: These are the obstacles owners hit most — and we take them off your hands
marketingLanding.challenge1Desc: Price above the market and demand stops; below it and you lose a large sum.
marketingLanding.challenge2Desc: Quick phone snaps kill interest before anyone comes to view.
marketingLanding.challenge3Desc: Plenty of calls and messages, few of them genuinely ready to buy or rent.
marketingLanding.challenge4Desc: A listing in one place reaches only a fraction of the searchers.
marketingLanding.challenge5Desc: Repeated haggling without a clear price reference ends in needless concessions.
marketingLanding.challenge6Desc: Regulatory steps that need close follow-up so the deal does not stall.
marketingLanding.tiersTitle: Choose how your property is marketed
marketingLanding.tiersSubtitle: Two clear packages, no hidden fees
marketingLanding.tier1Tagline: To put your property in front of searchers, properly presented
marketingLanding.tier1Feature1: Price assessment based on market data
marketingLanding.tier1Feature3: Listing published on the Razeem platform
marketingLanding.tier1Feature4: Caller screening, with serious enquiries passed to you
marketingLanding.tier1Feature5: Monthly report on views and interest
marketingLanding.tier2Tagline: A full campaign, run through to a completed deal
marketingLanding.tier2Feature2: Professional photography and a video tour
marketingLanding.tier2Feature4: Paid advertising campaign on social platforms
marketingLanding.tier2Feature6: Transfer and paperwork followed through to handover
marketingLanding.stepsSubtitle: Four steps from the first call to a completed deal
marketingLanding.step1Desc: We visit the property and set a realistic price based on comparable deals in the same district.
marketingLanding.step2Desc: We prepare the property and photograph it so its space and strengths actually show.
marketingLanding.step3Desc: We publish the listing and back it with a campaign that reaches genuinely interested searchers.
marketingLanding.step4Desc: We take the offers, negotiate on your behalf, and follow the paperwork through to transfer.
marketingLanding.advantagesSubtitle: Nine reasons owners market with us
marketingLanding.advantage1Desc: We work from real deals in your district, not general estimates.
marketingLanding.advantage2Desc: Thousands browse the platform every month looking for a property like yours.
marketingLanding.advantage3Desc: Professional photography and copy lift interest before the first viewing.
marketingLanding.advantage4Desc: We take the calls and pass on only the serious ones, so your time is not wasted.
marketingLanding.advantage5Desc: We negotiate from a clear price reference that protects your margin.
marketingLanding.advantage6Desc: Targeted campaigns that reach the people interested in your property type and area.
marketingLanding.advantage7Desc: You see views, calls and viewings as they happen.
marketingLanding.advantage8Desc: We stay with you through transfer and registration so the deal does not stall at the last step.
marketingLanding.advantage9Desc: We market your property for sale or for rent, whichever suits you.
marketingLanding.faq1Q: How much is the marketing commission?
marketingLanding.faq1A: The commission is a percentage of the deal value and varies by package and property type. We state it in writing before marketing begins, and there are no hidden fees.
marketingLanding.faq2Q: Do I pay anything if the property does not sell?
marketingLanding.faq2A: Brokerage commission is due only on a completed deal. Preparation services such as photography and paid campaigns are agreed separately in advance.
marketingLanding.faq3Q: How long does a sale usually take?
marketingLanding.faq3A: It depends on type, location and price. Our average is around 45 days, and it is far shorter when the pricing is realistic from the start.
marketingLanding.faq4Q: Do you market for rent as well?
marketingLanding.faq4A: Yes — for sale and for rent, residential and commercial alike.
marketingLanding.faq5A: On the Premium package we arrange and accompany every viewing. On Essential we pass serious enquiries to you and you handle the viewing yourself.
marketingLanding.faq6Q: Can I stop the marketing at any time?
marketingLanding.faq6A: Yes. The agreement can be ended with prior notice, and we hand over everything produced for your property, photography included.
marketingLanding.ctaTitle: Ready to put your property in front of thousands of searchers?
marketingLanding.ctaSubtitle: Send your property details today and our marketing team will contact you within one business day.
